title: Walking with God
definition: Walking with God means living in ongoing fellowship, trust, obedience, repentance, and dependence upon Him.
summary: God calls His people to daily faithfulness, not occasional religious interest. Walking with God involves the whole life.
christFocus: Through Christ and the Spirit, believers are brought into fellowship with God and empowered to walk in obedience.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God calls His people to daily faithfulness, not occasional religious interest. Walking with God involves the whole life.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
